question: Nice to meet you, Mr. Oda! I've been wondering, is Ideo (NOTE: Originally written Idea, probably a typing error) the Boxer based from the old robot show Ideon? Robo Sasa (age 38)
answer: That's right. I took the idea from the old robot anime show Ideon. Sorry, I had so many characters to introduce. I started having too much fun with them. It was like a robot with extended shoulders like this on the right. It was the very first plastic model I got as a kid.
